r1-handoff.title: Handoff compliance
r1-handoff.imperative: Did the change do what the handoff asked, within its allowed scope? Record pass/fail with a finding.
r1-handoff.finding: All 5 close criteria independently verified. (1) Density=measured rho: re-ran an independent spot-check (2023 Mexico, different script than the test) -- moist_air_density_from_pressure(pressure_hpa*100, air_temp_c, humidity_pct) from telemetry_store.tele_weather == stored frame rho bit-identically (0.9052291730225163 both sides); confirmed NOT fixed 1.2 (RHO_REF_KG_M3=1.225 via ISA-through-measured-formula) and NOT altitude lookup (bit-identical match to the measured-pressure fn rules out the buggy altitude path). (2) Residual=axis-explained with sigma in quadrature (stored_sigma^2+density_fit_sigma^2+mass_component_sigma^2+fallback_penalty^2); 4 mass-normalized axes (brake_decel_ms2, traction_accel_ms2, lateral_mech_grip_g, coast_rolling_decel_ms2) independently confirmed exact no-ops on the full real frame (explained==0 all rows, residual-raw max abs diff==0.0). (3) Falsifiability PROVEN by direct simulation: force-broke density handling (beta treated as 0, as if density were ignored) on drag_area_closed_m2/max_power_w and re-ran mexico_monaco_residual_consistency -- z_resid==z_raw exactly and the improvement assertion (mean_z_resid < 0.85*mean_z_raw) genuinely FAILS under the broken condition (test_would_pass=False both axes), proving this is not confirmatory-by-construction. Real (unbroken) numbers reproduce bit-for-bit against the implementer's reported table (drag 2.512->1.632, power 1.665->0.849). Log-space handled via ln(rho) throughout the beta fit/application (density is multiplicative); merge is an inner join on (year,constructor) i.e. shared car-seasons only. Real margin vs ceiling (ratios 0.65/0.51 vs 0.85 ceiling) -- not massaged to a razor edge. Honest disclosure that beta is largely Mexico-vs-rest identified (a real methodological limit, correctly flagged as a triage candidate, not hidden). (4) Honest magnitude: 7/11 axes get real explained components, 4/11 exact no-op, correctly reported not inflated. (5) No evo import (grep -i evo on both files: no matches beyond docstring prose, no import lines); no data/*.db in git status --porcelain (grep -i .db: no matches).

r4-quality.title: Quality vs inherited rules
r4-quality.imperative: Does the change meet the inherited project/section rules (the handoff's constraints)? Append a check per rule. Record pass/fail with a finding.
r4-quality.finding: Per-rule check: Handoff Constraints -- (1) py invocation used throughout, verified. (2) Density from measured pressure only via environment.moist_air_density_from_pressure -- confirmed, no fixed/altitude fallback path used. (3) Log-space cross-track density comparison -- confirmed: ln(rho) used throughout fit_density_betas and apply_layer1 (d_lnrho = ln_rho - ln(RHO_REF_KG_M3)), never a linear rho ratio. (4) Absolute main-checkout DB paths -- frame.DB_PATH='C:/Programs/f1Brainz/data/physics_estimates.db', telemetry_store.DEFAULT_STORE_PATH='C:/Programs/f1Brainz/data/telemetry_store.db', both absolute, both read via the test's real_frame/TelemetryStore() fixtures (no worktree-relative path). (5) constraint:physics_region_no_evo_import -- grep -i evo on both files: no import-line matches. (6) Every layer carries explicit sigma -- layer1_sigma column added per axis, combines stored_sigma+density_fit_sigma+mass_component_sigma+fallback_penalty in quadrature. CREW_CONTEXT.md rules -- no print()/logging debris (grep empty); module scope holds only immutable constants (frozensets, floats, one derived-at-import RHO_REF_KG_M3) + pure functions/one frozen dataclass, no mutable state; all thresholds (MASS_ELASTICITY, MASS_ELASTICITY_SIGMA, MIN_WEEKENDS_FOR_BETA, RHO_FALLBACK_INFLATION) are named module constants, not inline magic numbers; L1 (analytical-reference) truth-anchored test present and explicitly labeled as such in TestRhoMatchesMeasuredPressure's docstring, satisfying the Physics-And-Units truth-anchored-test rule; missingness handled explicitly via .notna() masks and isna-aware equality checks, no silent imputation. Verification-by-region due diligence: re-ran the full tests/unit/physics/weekend_state/ region (43 tests, g1+g2 combined) fresh -- 43 passed, no regression to g1's prior work from g2's addition.
